semiconductor_relevance: High — Advanced Dicing Technologies specializes in dicing equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Advanced Dicing Technologies (ADT) is a leading supplier of semiconductor dicing equipment and solutions, focusing on the development and manufacturing of systems, blades, and processes for dicing silicon-based integrated circuits and microelectronic components. The company provides comprehensive dicing solutions tailored to meet diverse customer requirements, enhancing the localization of semiconductor equipment.
capabilities: Dicing equipment with varying levels of automation
Manufacturing of annular resin/nickel/metal sintered blades
Peripheral instrumentation and accessories for dicing

regional_presence.Israel: ADT maintains an overseas R&D and production base in Israel.
regional_presence.China: Zhengzhou serves as the headquarters and R&D and production base for the new ADT, with Shanghai as its sales center.
